newsitem.title: GERMANY: Aero International (Regional) wins $84mln US order.
newsitem.headline: Aero International (Regional) wins $84mln US order.

text.p: European aircraft manufacturer Aero International (Regional) said a contract to supply 12 aircraft to U.S. carrier Atlantic Coast Airlines was worth $84 million.
The regional airline said on December 4 it would buy 12 29-passenger Jetstream 41 aircraft from the European consortium but did not reveal a purchase price.
An AI(R) statement said that the aircraft would be delivered between 1997 and 1999 and would increase the ACA fleet to 40 Jetstream aircraft.
ACA president Kerry Skenn said the Jetstream 41 provided very low operating costs and had generated positive passenger reaction.
Aero International (Regional) is the joint sales and marketing subsidiary of French group Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
